scope: Read-only independent review of the result-consumption fix; no product edits and no duplicate test/build runs.
previous_finding: social-readonly-review.json described metadata discarded by a post-decision read tool.

verified_by_inspection.evidence: runAgentCycle awaits buildContext before getClaudeClient().decide; buildSocialBriefContext awaits both reader calls; real.ts serializes this context in the SDK message. The old post-decision social_status tool is removed from this agent.

executionMode is supplied from server state and strict isMock === false. Missing/live-unknown/simulation modes and missing brief return from the builder without reader.execute. getClaudeClient caches the selected real/mock instance.

The builder ignores _trigger, uses the engine-provided userId and prepared pendingBrief/executionMode. The existing reader still validates owner UUID, fixed agent capability, scoped SQL and returned rows including sentinel.

Rejected/non-read pages become explicit unavailable resources without items. Promise.allSettled preserves the available resource. Context marks partial/unavailable separately, fixed first-page limits 14/10, atomicSnapshot false and providerHealth not_checked; underlying hasMore/nextAfterId remain intact.

definition.pendingBriefKey keeps privateTrace enabled independently of the removed read tool. Decision, params/results, notifications, stored run outcome and replay remain minimized by the existing engine.

socialStatusCycle.test.ts preserves the actual Supabase and model SDKs but replaces HTTP boundaries; asserts scoped SQL, SDK context, derived PDF params, read-before-decide ordering, two bounded parallel queries, no reads for excluded modes, foreign-sentinel exclusion and trace canaries.

test_result_reported_by_parent.note: Parent is also executing full KARTA tests, typecheck and build; this reviewer did not duplicate them.

limitations: The context is a bounded first-page view sorted by UUID, not a most-recent or exhaustive social history.
No new provider health check or publication occurs.
No real database, model API, account or social provider was exercised in this review.
The existing per-page deadlines bound waiting; synchronous JavaScript remains non-preemptible.
